messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: spike in external function/tool invocations on /v1/tool/invoke. 5xx rate up ~6x, queue latency climbing >2s. auto-scaling not keeping up. paging morgan oncall.

morgan: on it — what region/tenants?

anika: seeing concentrated traffic from eu-west-1 and a handful of tenants on free and pro plans. KV cache memory pressure + tail latency for streaming structured outputs.

samir: confirmed. root cause looks like a sudden agent fanout from a botnet/test harness hitting tool-calls. proposal: 1) immediate soft-rate-limit for /v1/tool/invoke globally 2) drop structured JSON output for streaming responses -> plain text fallback 3) throttle concurrent execs per-tenant. keeps basic text gen online.

morgan: agree. prioritize minimal blast radius. can we implement via routing-policy toggles?

devex-bot: Rolling config:router toggle request queued: reduce_invoke_qps=0.2, structured_output_mode=plaintext_stream, per_tenant_exec_limit=2 — awaiting approval.

morgan: approving rollout. go ahead.

devex-bot: APPLY: POST /internal/config/routes/override 

```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/config/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"scope":"global","overrides": {"invoke_qps_scale":0.2,"structured_output":"plaintext","exec_concurrency_per_tenant":2}}'
```

devex-bot: rollout started (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%), estimating 3m to full.

anika: telemetry shows immediate drop in 5xxs on canary nodes. KV pressure easing. tail latency dropping. good sign.

lisa-sre: prepare incident note and customer comms. if we keep structured_output disabled for >30m, we need banner & status page update.

eva-cs: Drafting short CS blurb: "We're seeing elevated invocation rates affecting tool-based features. We've temporarily limited external tool invocations and switched tool responses to text-only streaming to protect latency. No data loss expected. We'll update as we have ETA for full restore." share?

morgan: ping legal/security — any data exposure concerns from this change?

anika: no, change reduces structured metadata emission; it's conservative.

samir: adding rate limits to billing tiers only for now — keep dedicated tenants at normal throughput. config updated: "exclude_plans": ["dedicated"]

morgan: good. runbooks: rollback command in case of regressions: set invoke_qps_scale=1 and structured_output=structured. who will monitor next 30m?

lisa-sre: i'll watch dashboards and logs, samir on infra alerts, anika on app metrics.

devex-bot: rollout finished to 100% (3241590238).

anika: metrics stable, 5xx down to baseline, queues cleared.

morgan: ok continue to monitor. create follow-up to evaluate hardened per-tenant protection (circuit breakers + attribution). assign to eng-runtime.

eva-cs: CS note posted to status.redwood.ai and sent to affected customers (ticketed).

lisa-sre: handing to next on-call in 35m for watch and postmortem kickoff. :white_check_mark:

samir: leaving a quick mitigation log for postmortem: what/why/actions/timestamps + rollback plan.

morgan: thanks team. putting incident in "mitigated" state; will open postmortem doc and link.

infra-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigated by config toggles at 3241590190. follow-up: postmortem assigned to eng-runtime, scheduled 24h.
